discordauth-desc: Continue with Discord using shared CentralAuth accounts.
discordauth-login-help: Use your Discord account to sign in or create a wiki account.
discordauth-expired: Your Discord sign-in session expired or could not be verified. Please start again.
discordauth-cancelled: Discord sign-in was cancelled. You can try again or use your wiki password.
discordauth-failed: Discord sign-in could not be completed. Please try again later or use your wiki password.
discordauth-already-linked: This Discord account or wiki account is already linked. Sign in to the existing account to manage its sign-in methods.
discordauth-set-password: Set a wiki password before removing Discord so you can still sign in to your account.
